visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and a white-and-black striped halter top is seen in a medium shot indoors. She holds two 9-pan eyeshadow palettes toward the camera, gesturing with her hands as she speaks. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a human forearm outdoors under bright natural sunlight, showing horizontal swatches of various brown, pink, and shimmer eyeshadows. (3) Back to the indoor setting, the woman uses a blue makeup brush to apply a light matte brown shade to her eyelid while looking slightly off-camera. (4) In a series of close-up shots of her eyes, she demonstrates applying different shades from the palette: a darker brown to the lash line, a shimmering pink to the lower lash area, and a bright gold glitter to the center of the eyelid using her fingertip. (5) A split-screen or montage sequence shows the completed 'Natural' makeup look (labeled) followed by a 'Heavy' makeup look where she uses darker, smokier shades from the same palette. She poses with her hand under her chin, smiling slightly.
